title: Trial of the Dreadscale: Moderate
summary: A cooperative movement trial with four health locks and moderate difficulty.
overview: A cooperative movement trial with four health locks and moderate difficulty.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Bring at least three players and respond to the floor markers together.
This difficulty gives 5.5 seconds for ordinary hazard warnings.
At 80%, occupy all three seals and hold them for 3.5 seconds.
At 60%, dodge the sweeping fields, then gather three players in the blue rally circle.
At 40%, divide the group between the two violet circles and keep both sides balanced.
At 20%, survive the final patterns. A failed trial causes a short empowered attack window before the trial repeats.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 3.
Training encounter grants no loot or replay lockout. Ground geometry and client marker presentation remain unverified in game.
